subject: general
question: What is the name of the new regulatory body formed by the Reserve Bank of India in May 2025 to supervise India’s payment systems?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Payments Regulatory Board**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Payments Regulatory Board** (**PRB**) is the newly constituted body under the **Reserve Bank of India** (**RBI**) established to regulate and supervise the payment and settlement systems in **India**.
 
• Formed in **May 2025**, the board was created to provide a more focused and specialized regulatory framework for the rapidly evolving digital payments landscape, ensuring **financial stability** and consumer trust.
 
• The **PRB** replaces the erstwhile **Board for Regulation and Supervision of Payment and Settlement Systems** (**BPSS**), which previously functioned as a sub-committee of the Central Board of the **RBI**.
